invariants.statement: Every clone page renders with zero runtime requests to non-local origins; all assets are vendored under clone/static/ and the payment, wallet, support-chat, consent, analytics and review third parties are rendered per captured markup without any remote call.

The clone-local checkout accepts only an opaque local-sandbox scenario identifier. No card number, cardholder name, expiry, security code, bank or wallet credential is ever accepted, stored or logged, and no field capable of carrying one is offered.

Completing checkout consumes a sandbox approval and writes the subscription and its order row in one SQLite transaction; a declined scenario creates neither; a retryable scenario succeeds only on retry; a duplicate submission is idempotent.

The three billing periods and two tiers render exactly the captured prices, struck-through retail totals, promo and renewal copy, and feature rows; switching a period changes the displayed prices and never mixes two periods' figures.

The checkout flow parameter binds tier and period, and the order summary's line item, discount, estimated tax and total due are derived server-side from the catalogue rather than accepted from the client.

Subscriber routes redirect anonymous visitors to the sign-in entry preserving the intended destination; an authenticated visit to the sign-in entry redirects to the dashboard; sessions use a __Host- cookie issued through the site-backend seam.
An unmatched path answers HTTP 404 with the home page as its body, matching the source exactly: no branded not-found view, no '404' string, primary navigation intact.
A subscriber's subscription, orders, billing history and contact details are invisible to and unmodifiable by any other subscriber or anonymous visitor.
Resetting and reseeding yields byte-stable business state: the same plan catalogue, the same seeded accounts, the same subscription and order fixtures.
Password-reset and subscription-confirmation mail exist only through the site-backend seam's local outbox; reset codes are never stored in plaintext, logged, or written into an outbox body.

Every control a frozen journey depends on is operable by a real click at its captured viewport: the three billing-period tabs, the plan CTAs, the payment-method rows, the registration form's submit, the sign-in and recovery submits, and the dashboard's plan-change, pause, cancel and reactivate actions.
acceptance_obligations: Carried over from the JEFIT run, where passing API tests, a clean static diagnostic and a passing pixel oracle all missed four controls that rendered but could not be operated. Assert operability in the browser, not merely that a POST endpoint accepts data.
